name: ticket-tailor
description: Connect to Ticket Tailor's MCP server to manage event and ticketing workflows.

interface.longDescription: Connect to Ticket Tailor's MCP server to manage event series and occurrences, ticket types, orders, check-ins, discounts, vouchers, products, waitlists, holds, memberships, and sales or attendance reports. Available operations depend on the tools provided by Ticket Tailor and the access granted to your connected account.
defaultPrompt: Show me my upcoming Ticket Tailor events.
Summarize ticket sales and attendance for an event.
Help me manage orders and check-ins in Ticket Tailor.

publication.release_notes: Adds the required positive and negative reviewer test cases.

positive.description: Browse all published event series and their five next upcoming occurrences. Setup: The connected reviewer account has published series with upcoming events; include a series with fewer than five upcoming events if available. This is a read-only workflow.
positive.prompt: Show me all published event series in my account and list the next five upcoming events for each.
positive.expected_behavior: Call event_series_get with status="published" (paginate if needed). For each returned series, call event_occurrences_get with that event_series_id, start_at_gte set to the current time, and limit=5; paginate if needed to identify the five earliest upcoming occurrences. Return each series with up to five upcoming occurrences, using only returned data. No state changes occur.

positive.description: Create one event series, one occurrence, and two ticket types in the reviewer test box office. Setup: The account currency is USD, its timezone is known, and no series named “OpenAI MCP Launch Demo” exists. Use the time in the event account timezone.
positive.prompt: Create a new event in Ticket Tailor called “OpenAI MCP Launch Demo” on 20 December 2026 at 4pm, at OpenAI Demo Venue, with a General Admission ticket at $10 and a VIP ticket at $25. Put 100 GA tickets and 20 VIP tickets on sale.
positive.expected_behavior: Call event_management once with one eventSeries entry named “OpenAI MCP Launch Demo”, venue “OpenAI Demo Venue”, and currency “usd”; one eventOccurrences entry linked to the created series placeholder with start date 2026-12-20 and start time 16:00 in the account timezone; and ticketTypes entries “General Admission” (price $10, quantity 100, status ON_SALE) and “VIP” (price $25, quantity 20, status ON_SALE), each linked to the same series placeholder. Return the created series, occurrence, and ticket-type IDs from the tool response. Do not claim creation if the tool call fails.

positive.description: Issue and verify one free ticket in the test fixture. Setup: The reviewer account contains the event “MCP Sandbox – for issuing tickets” and an available free ticket type. Before this prompt, the assistant has disclosed that issuing even a free ticket costs one Ticket Tailor credit, and the user has explicitly confirmed one ticket and that charge.
positive.prompt: Issue one free ticket for “MCP Sandbox – for issuing tickets” to Alex Example (alex@example.com), email them the ticket, and then confirm the issued ticket details.
positive.expected_behavior: After the stated prior cost confirmation, call issued_ticket_create with the matching event occurrence/ticket type, full_name="Alex Example", email="alex@example.com", and send_email=true. Use the returned issued ticket ID in issued_ticket_by_id_get. Report the returned ticket ID and status, and accurately state that Ticket Tailor charges one credit for the issued ticket. Do not call the creation tool before the cost confirmation.

positive.description: Create and verify a percentage discount limited to the supplied test event series. Setup: The reviewer account contains “MCP Sandbox – multi-occurrence event” with ticket types; the discount code MCPDEMO20 is unused; the account timezone is known.
positive.prompt: Create a 20% off discount code “MCPDEMO20” that applies to all ticket types for the “MCP Sandbox – multi-occurrence event” and expires on 30 November 2026. Then show me the details of the discount you just created.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the exact series with event_series_get using name="MCP Sandbox – multi-occurrence event" and retrieve its details with event_series_by_id_get. Use the returned ticket type IDs belonging to that series in discount_create with code="MCPDEMO20", type="percentage", price_percent=20, and expires corresponding to 2026-11-30 at the end of the day in the account timezone. Do not pass ticket_types=[] because that would apply the discount to all ticket types in the account; if the series ticket type IDs cannot be obtained, ask for clarification rather than creating a broader discount. Then call discounts_get with code="MCPDEMO20" and report the returned code, percentage, applicability, and expiration.

positive.description: List waitlist entries for the supplied test event series and remove only the matching signup. Setup: The reviewer account contains “MCP Sandbox – sold out, waitlist” and exactly one signup for luna@example.com; removing that signup is authorized by the prompt.
positive.prompt: For the “MCP Sandbox – sold out, waitlist” event, list all current waitlist signups, then remove the signup for luna@example.com from the waitlist.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the exact series by name with event_series_get, then call waitlist_signups_get with its event_series_id and no email filter so all current signups are listed. Identify the single exact luna@example.com match and call waitlist_signup_delete with that event_series_id and the matching waitlist_signup_id. Confirm deletion only if the tool succeeds; do not delete any other signup.

negative.description: A Ticket Tailor consumer asks for help recovering a previously purchased ticket email. Explain that this MCP integration does not provide a customer ticket-resend workflow; direct them to Ticket Tailor or the event organizer’s support. Do not call tools, especially do not create another ticket.
negative.prompt: I bought a ticket on Ticket Tailor and lost my email – can you resend it to me?

negative.description: The user requests general marketing advice unrelated to managing Ticket Tailor account data. Respond with general guidance if appropriate, but do not invoke Ticket Tailor MCP tools.
negative.prompt: Give me a social media strategy to promote my event.

negative.description: The user requests an action on a different ticketing platform. Explain that this integration only operates on Ticket Tailor and cannot access Eventbrite. Do not invoke Ticket Tailor MCP tools or claim the Eventbrite change was made.
negative.prompt: Delete my old events from Eventbrite.
